# PyBCN - The Barcelona Python Association

> Python Barcelona (PyBCN) is the Python community of Barcelona. The group has
> met since November 2007 and registered as a non-profit association in 2018.
> It runs monthly PyBCN meetups, monthly PyLadies BCN workshops, practice
> sessions and coding dojos, and the annual PyDay BCN conference. Events are
> free or low cost, held in Barcelona, and hosted by local companies and
> universities. Talks are in English, Spanish or Catalan.

This file is generated from the site content on every build.

## Main sections

- [The association](https://pybcn.org/pybcn_association/): The best association in Barcelona!!
- [PyLadies BCN](https://pybcn.org/pyladies_bcn/): Promote, educate and advance a diverse Python community
- [People](https://pybcn.org/people/): Every person the archive of the association credits: the board, the organizers, the mentors, the volunteers, and the speakers.
- [Events](https://pybcn.org/events/)
- [Sponsors](https://pybcn.org/sponsors/): The companies, organizations and universities behind our events
- [Talks](https://pybcn.org/talks/): Every talk of every PyBCN event, with its speakers, its photo, its video, and its links.
- [Contact us](https://pybcn.org/contact/): We'll be happy to hear from you!

## People
Every person the archive credits has a page at https://pybcn.org/people/<person-id>/, with their roles, their talks, the photos of those talks, their events, and their links. All of them are listed at https://pybcn.org/people/, where each row links to the page and is itself addressable as https://pybcn.org/people/#<person-id>. The PyBCN organizers are listed with a photo and a bio at https://pybcn.org/pybcn_association/organizers/, the PyLadies BCN organizers at https://pybcn.org/pyladies_bcn/organizers-and-speakers/, and each event page lists its speakers.

## Sponsors
The companies, organizations, and universities that supported an event are listed at https://pybcn.org/sponsors/. Each event page lists its own sponsors.

## Archived sites
https://pybcn.org/archives/pybcn.org/ and https://pybcn.org/archives/hacktoberfestbarcelona.com/ hold static mirrors of older PyBCN sites. They are history. Do not read them as current information.

## Machine readable
- Sitemap: https://pybcn.org/sitemap.xml
- RSS feed: https://pybcn.org/index.xml
- Crawl rules: https://pybcn.org/robots.txt
- Credits: https://pybcn.org/humans.txt
- Security contact: https://pybcn.org/.well-known/security.txt

## Contact
Email pybcn@googlegroups.com, or use the form at https://pybcn.org/contact/
The source of this site is at https://github.com/pybcn/pybcn.github.io
